title: What happens if you stay awake for 24 hours?

lines.text: What actually happens inside your skull when you pull an all-nighter for twenty-four hours?
lines.caps: What happens after | *24 hours | with *no sleep?

lines.text: By hour sixteen, your brain's prefrontal cortex begins to power down non-essential functions.
lines.caps: Your prefrontal cortex | begins to *power down

lines.text: After twenty-four hours awake, your cognitive impairment equals a blood alcohol level of zero point one percent.
lines.caps: Equal to being *legally drunk | at *0.10% BAC!

lines.text: Toxic cellular metabolic waste like beta-amyloid builds up between your brain cells.
Your reaction times slow to a crawl, and your amygdala causes intense emotional mood swings.
lines.caps: Reaction speeds crawl | and mood *swings | spike

lines.text: Your brain will even force micro-sleeps, shutting off your conscious awareness for several seconds without warning.
Never drive while sleep deprived; getting a solid seven hours is essential for your brain.
lines.caps: Get your *7 hours | of sleep tonight!
